jobs.name: zaphoid-github-backup
jobs.prompt:
Run the Hermes configuration backup script to snapshot Zaphoid's configuration and push it to GitHub.

Execute the script at: ~/.hermes/scripts/github-backup/backup.sh

Steps:
1. Run `bash ~/.hermes/scripts/github-backup/backup.sh` 
2. Check the exit code and the last few lines of ~/.hermes/logs/github-backup.log
3. Report the result: success (with commit message if any changes), "no changes" if nothing changed, or the error message if it failed.

Keep the report brief — one or two sentences maximum. Example: "✅ Backup pushed: 'backup: 2026-06-01 06:00 AEST — auto snapshot'" or "✅ No config changes since last backup." or "❌ Backup failed: [error]"
